{{Quote|This is Palmer on the southern ridge. We've picked up Trade Federation forces heading our way, fast.|Palmer|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
'''Palmer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. During the conflict, she was captured by the Trade Federation and later released by her fellow officer, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]]. Palmer went on to [[Battle of the south ridge|participate]] in [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|several]] of the conflicts waged on Naboo during the invasion, but was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Naboo during the final [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] to secure the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The tractors nabbed me. I need help here. I can't escape. Where's my cover? Aaaaah!|Palmer's last words|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
Palmer was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual born on the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and had become an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], she was captured during the first [[Capture of Theed/Legends|stages]] of the invasion. She was later rescued by fellow officer [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] return from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]&mdash;where the Queen was trying to end the invasion in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Palmer was stationed at a Naboo [[Naboo Resistance|resistance]] [[Naboo airbase|base]] on the south ridge of the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of Naboo, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The base came under [[Battle of the south ridge|attack]] by elements of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], and she contacted Sykes for assistance. While Sykes was racing to the base, she repeatedly called for reinforcements. Sykes arrived soon after and destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attackers.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Palmer later participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake Theed]], leading [[Group 2]], a squad of [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash Speeders]]. During the battle, Group 3 became pinned down in a plaza, and Palmer was once again saved by Sykes' actions. After the rescue, Palmer and Group 3 helped Sykes escort the [[Naboo commando transport|commando transport]] to the [[Theed Courthouse]]. At the conclusion of the battle, she flew in an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] with [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] to attack the Trade Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Naboo, which was controlling the Droid [[Army/Legends|Army]]. During the space battle, her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was caught in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. As she called for assistance, she was pulled into range of the control ship's [[Turbolaser/Legends|guns]], which knocked out her fighter's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Personality and traits==
As a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying for the people of Naboo, Palmer was capable of piloting a number of craft ranging from the Flash speeder to the N-1 starfighter. She was also capable of leading a squad of Flash speeders into battle. Whenever she was under attack, she repeatedly called for reinforcements.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Palmer was a minor character created for the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. She was later given an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. Although Palmer was not listed by name in the game's credits, [[Bobbie Block|Samantha Paris]] was credited with voicing "RSF officer 2."
